name: Reset All Last Time Stamps
purpose: Resets the sync cursors for all QBO entities so the next sync reads everything again: clears getQBOTimeStamp and sets getQBOStartPosition to 1 for every QBOEntity record found on the SyncLog layout.
writes:
QBOEntity::getQBOTimeStamp#2 (step 4, found set on entry, Replace Field Contents with empty)
QBOEntity::getQBOStartPosition#27 (step 5, found set on entry, Replace Field Contents with 1)
callers: none found (may be called by name)
open_question: Replace Field Contents runs on the current found set of the QBO table on the SyncLog layout; the script does not show all records first, so the scope depends on the caller's found set. Needs confirmation that it is all QBOEntity rows.
